answer: Block sybil mills printing keys for free. Each identity carves its key in a basalt slab, washes grooves with umber, and sets it in the zephyr vent one day; airflow fixes the depth, auditors match the gradient to its chart. Its slot is held all day, serving one identity only. Faking N accounts takes N slabs, N slots, N parallel days: 18x honest cost, and a borrowed slab fails, gradient matching another key. Honest users pay one slab, one day.
